column1: # RSpace BagDelta exact-key mutation: root replay versus one moving PathMap write zipper.
# Measured implementation: 87679597d. Adaptive production selection: 9a746f2bf (empty/singleton direct; multi-key cursor).
# Host: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX, 32 physical cores, SMT disabled; governor performance; amd-pstate-epp; pinned to CPUs 0-7. Immediate preflight sample was 74% aggregate idle.

# Command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryHigh=6G -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 taskset -c 0-7 cargo bench -p rspace_plus_plus --bench bag -- bag_atomic_delta_batch_shared_prefix --sample-size 51 --warm-up-time 2 --measurement-time 5 --noplot
# Fixture: 16,384 pre-existing shared-prefix keys. Each delta splits its cardinality between exact removals and new shared-prefix additions; odd cardinality assigns the extra operation to additions.

# Criterion: one preregistered run, 51 regression samples per arm and cardinality, 2 s warm-up, 5 s requested measurement time. The enclosing scope was capped at 8 GiB with zero swap; a post-exit peak-RSS value was unavailable and is not inferred.

# Primary decision (pgmcp experiment/hypothesis 219, delta cardinality 256): statistically ACCEPTED. Welch t=-5.3009697178, p=4.5845472558e-7, Cohen's d=-1.0497484283, mean-difference 95% CI [-608.7007813876,-276.5862932072] ns. Both arms departed from normality; robustness Cliff's delta=-0.4717416378 and Mann-Whitney p=4.0848091004e-5.

# Engineering interpretation: the primary median improves 1.197% and does not meet the campaign's separate five-percent end-to-end selection threshold by itself. Singleton cursor setup regresses 8.289%; therefore 9a746f2bf retains the direct exact-key path for zero/one change and the cursor for multi-key deltas, where common prefixes can be reused.
